_about: Weather work: files that must not change (sha256 of the file with CRLF normalised to LF), recorded at base_commit from the clean tree. test_weather_isolation.py checks them. app.py and VideoGenerator.spec are not listed: Weather may only ADD lines to them (phase 1B, approved separately); the test checks that no line of theirs was removed or changed except the approved ones (phase 1B: the two STYLE_CHOICES loops in app.py, now _style_choices()). approved_importers: the only existing modules that may import Weather (app.py, inside its Weather methods). Refresh deliberately, never to hide a change. 2026-10-14 (approved by the owner): pakmap-engine/render.mjs and the new pakmap-engine/lib/footage_pass.mjs -- frames that are only a full-screen video clip skip the browser (Hybrid/Weather specs only; pakMap unchanged). 2026-10-15 (approved by the owner): asset_manager.py -- a scene that only changed its number reuses its saved file (AssetManager._reuse_by_content), so nothing is fetched or paid for twice in any style. 2026-10-15 (approved by the owner): hybrid/generate.py -- the channel name is laid over the finished video (add_watermark), so footage-only frames skip the page in Hybrid Map and Weather too. 2026-10-16 (asked for by the owner: no plan or one missing clip may stop a video): asset_manager.py -- AssetManifest re-reads before each write, so a Generate run's stale copy no longer puts a Retry's fetched scene back to FAILED; providers/stock/base.py -- a stock clip too big to download keeps its first seconds, else the next result. 2026-10-16 (owner): video_generator.py -- Whisper reports its progress while it transcribes; providers/stock/base.py -- the first-30s fallback is time-limited and logs why it failed. 2026-10-16 (owner): video_generator.py -- Whisper reads audio decoded by ffmpeg (a damaged mp3 frame no longer ends the transcript); starmap -- footage clips fit a 2.2 s minimum, music recovers in 0.3 s between sentences. 2026-10-17 (approved by the owner): commit 5403eb8, app-wide upgrade -- video_generator.py: aligner inflection tolerance and far-duplicate guard, Ken Burns stills read once (byte-identical output); app.py: shared button roles/heights, clearer error messages, log batching, Settings lifecycle fixes (lines changed, none removed from Weather). 2026-10-17 (approved by the owner): the StarMap camera/cinema/never-stop work (starmap/, starmap-engine/, its prompts and textures, new modules cinema/repair/tracking/thumbnails/script_check/subject_check), pakmap/compile.py, video_generator.py and editorial/shot_planner.py from the same-clip restart fix, and app.py lines changed for What If in the style picker -- each file recorded at its new hash. 2026-10-17 (approved by the owner, Windows CI fix): asset_manager.py -- the manifest re-reads and re-replaces a file Windows holds locked for an instant instead of keeping a stale copy; starmap/cinema.py -- dates without strftime's %-d, which Windows rejects. 2026-10-17 (asked for by the owner: What If pictures stuck QUEUED and rendered as title cards): video_generator.py -- a pass of only commons_ rows gets the key-free stock search (Openverse carries Wikimedia Commons) instead of no provider. 2026-10-17 (asked for by the owner: the bugs seen in What If render #016): starmap/nasa_images.py -- a generic word (space, deep ...) is no evidence a NASA picture shows the subject, and a photo of people at a news conference is not the subject unless people are asked for; providers/stock/openverse.py -- a search can be limited to one collection; video_generator.py -- a pass of only commons_ rows searches Wikimedia Commons alone, never Pexels/Pixabay. 2026-10-18 (asked for by the owner: What If's styles in StarMap Cinema; What If sound, assets and stock fixes): starmap/, starmap-engine/page.js and the StarMap CSV prompt -- Cinema gains What If's templates and mission card (CSV template rows), information blocks, photo cards, graphics that hold to the cut and scene-following ambience, each a Cinema box (Classic StarMap unchanged); pakmap/sounds.py -- What If's audible ambience beds (wi_*); asset_manager.py -- a scene switched to another source is not overwritten by a running Flow batch; providers/base.py, providers/stock/base.py -- stock searches use the shot's subject words, Commons rows never broaden to one word; starmap/media.py -- a saved picture is only flagged, never re-fetched, by the What If render check. 2026-10-18 (approved by the owner: commit and push everything, CI green): the universal graphics work (gfx-core, gfx_templates.py) wired into pakMap and Hybrid -- pakmap/ (guard.py, compile.py, app_integration.py, audio_plan.py, schema.py, packaging.py), pakmap-engine/ (map_template event, check_gfx.mjs, samples, tests), hybrid/ template layers, the pakMap/Hybrid graphics prompts (new files, the originals unchanged); and the Doc Style work in graphics/ (doc_style, doc_plan, doc_looks) with graphics/render.py and video_generator.py -- each file recorded at its new hash; app.py lines changed only to pass the new switches.
